item: 2. CGN Shanwei Jiazi I: exact turbine model
proposal: No change to the turbine field ("78x Mingyang MySE 6.45 MW"): the sources conflict on the rotor.
note_zh: 汕尾海事局 2025-08 建成通告：78 部 6.45 MW，葉輪直徑 168 m、輪轂高 100 m、葉尖最低點距設計高水位 16 m（三個數字互相吻合）；GlobalData 寫明陽 MySE6.45-180（葉輪約 180 m），與 168 m 不符；中國電力網只寫「MySE6.45MW」。機型尾碼無法確定，維持原欄位。另：海事局通告顯示 2024-07 至 2026-12 正逐台更換主機（拆葉輪與主機、換新主機、裝回原葉輪）
note_en: Shanwei MSA completion notice (Aug 2025): 78 × 6.45 MW, rotor 168 m, hub 100 m, lowest tip 16 m above design high water (the three figures agree); GlobalData says Mingyang MySE6.45-180 (about 180 m rotor), which does not fit 168 m; China Power only says “MySE6.45MW”. The suffix cannot be settled, so the field stays. Also: MSA notices show the nacelles being replaced one by one from July 2024 to December 2026 (rotor and nacelle removed, new nacelle fitted, original rotor refitted)
why: No CGN, Mingyang, EIA or acceptance document naming the suffix was found: the CGN e-procurement static page for the 2019 Shanwei turbine lot 1 (CGN-201811080004, Mingyang first) is readable but gives no model; Mingyang 2022 half-year report, Houhu sea-use report (shanwei.gov.cn) and the MSA turbine list/layout attachments name no model. A 6.45 MW / 168 m combination is Goldwind’s GW168-6.45 (Goldwind was the second bidder in 2019), but nothing ties it to Jiazi I, so no change.

note_en: J. Mar. Sci. Eng. 2019 review: Bac Lieu is an example of pile cap foundations (citing a 2013 wind-resource paper); no contractor or owner text on the piles.
why: Vietnamese press (vietnamnet, nangluongvietnam, baochinhphu, vneec, vi.wikipedia) mention only the foundation packages; climateimpact.com has no foundation text; vdb.gov.vn fails TLS; MDPI pages 403 (the mdpi-res.com PDF works). khangducconst.com lists “Grounded: High-Rise Pile Cap” for Bac Lieu I/II, Tan An 1, V1-3 Ben Tre and V1-4, but the list is a copy of 4C Offshore’s database fields and is not used.
